metadata.fidelity: exact public no-tool hosted request boundary for documented four- and sixteen-agent settings; scheduler, plaintext intermediate state, and encrypted continuation remain closed or unimplemented
metadata.limits_scope: agent_count is provider-side; Scaffold Lab max_model_calls/max_concurrency/max_depth apply only to the observable outer request and do not constrain the hosted tree
metadata.accounting_scope: provider usage is aggregate; cost_usd uses provider-returned cost when available or the configured local token-price estimate, not necessarily an invoice charge
